batch.cross_item_pattern_note: Considered: in the 7 'reason for a procedural step' items (9a-P1-Q3, 9a-P2-Q4, 9a-P3-Q4, 9b-P1-Q2, 9b-P2-Q4, 9b-P4-Q3, 9b-P5-Q3), the key is the option naming a measurement confound or a matched condition. I found no mechanical form of this. A 'keeps something the same / not counted' wording rule also fires on distractors (9b-P2-Q4 A, B, D; 9b-P1-Q2 C), so selection rests on judging physical plausibility per item. Recorded item by item as no_source_needed instead. Also checked: 'both agree' CV items with the most general key (only 2: 9a-P7-Q6, 9b-P6-Q2), and Yes/No reasoning items. None meets the bar.
